title: manuscript-guard author approval
description: One author's approval of the manuscript, bound to what it said: the digest of the prose and the results as `check` reads them to say a build is current. Written by `manuscript-guard approve --as <author>`, one file per author under approvals/, and never by an agent: an approval is a person's statement. `submit` warns where an author has none, or approved a manuscript that has changed since.

author.description: The author's name as authors.yaml gives it.

document_sha256.description: What decides the built document when the author approved it: the manuscript's prose and the results.

front_sha256.description: What submit prints in the authors' names, as it prints it: the title page but for its word counts (the title, the running title, whether the paper is a demonstration, the authors with their degrees and equal-contribution marks, the affiliations, the equal-contribution note, the corresponding author's block, the ORCID iDs, the keywords), the CRediT statement and the declarations of funding and competing interests. A role named to sign a warning is not in it. An approval written without it is judged by document_sha256 alone.

note.description: Anything the author says with the approval, a condition included.
